Statement: I think it's always best to do things the usual way.
I always dress very carefully.
I find it very annoying when unexpected visitors show up without announcing themselves first.
Once I have formed an opinion, I stick to it.
When I leave my apartment, I regularly check whether I have turned off the stove or switched off the lights.
I am reluctant to change because I get very attached to things.
I proceed according to plan in everything I do.
From time to time, you should give up your habits and do something completely new.
When getting dressed, I always put my clothes on in exactly the same order.
I think that my way of doing things is usually the best, even if it doesn't seem that way at first.
New and unusual situations make me uncomfortable.
I don't care whether my apartment is tidy or not.
Every now and then I do something dangerous just for the fun of it.
I like to act according to the saying: "Better safe than sorry".
When I start something, I see it through to the end.
Unfortunately, I am sometimes unpunctual.
My wish for the future is to have as peaceful a life as possible.
The first impression you get of a person is almost always the right one.
A person is only truly significant when they devote themselves to a great cause.
People are the way they are; you can hardly change them.
It is much more important for children to learn to be independent and critical of their parents than to obey them.
Every person has a duty to stand up for the community into which they were born.
Political groups should be granted freedom of speech even if their goals are known to be dangerous.
People who are enthusiastic about many things can be relied upon just as much as others.
During a discussion, it is often necessary to repeat oneself several times to ensure that one is understood.
There are a lot of crazy ideas being spread around these days. With most of them, you can only shake your head that anyone would believe such a thing.
Women naturally think less clearly than men because they live more by their feelings.
In today's complicated world, the only way to find out what is happening is to rely on leading figures and experts.
It is okay to allow a child to disagree with their parents. Respect for parents remains nonetheless.
When making important personal decisions, one should rely on the advice of older, more experienced people.
It is better to change one's point of view than to stick to one that has been once accepted.
It is quite natural to be afraid of the future.
Some people must be hated because of the things they stand for.
You can get angry when someone stubbornly refuses to admit they are wrong.
Children should have a say in family decisions.
Women should be as interested in politics and social issues as they are in their families.
Left to their own devices, humans are helpless and pitiful creatures.
It is only natural that a man is more familiar with the ideas he believes to be right than with those he opposes.
There is far too much talk and discussion and far too little action.
Even today, women still have fewer rights than men. That must change.
People who have no love or respect for their parents can really only be despised.
